references.text: Earlier verses in the same chapter that establish the value system for vows concerning persons dedicated to the Lord, with different values based on age and gender.
Previous verses specifying the value for persons between five and twenty years old, showing the progressive age-based value structure.
The next verse providing provisions for those too poor to pay the set value, demonstrating flexibility in the vow system.
Refers to redemption money and valuation in shekels, illustrating the use of the shekel as a standard unit of measure in holy valuations.
Mentions the standard of the sanctuary shekel, which is the same unit of measure used in Leviticus 27 for valuations.
